subject: We blocked a sign-in attempt to your account
summary: Northwind Bank blocked a sign-in to Alex's online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT.
reason: A genuine-looking security alert about their own bank account; if it wasn't them, the password needs changing.
action: Check via Northwind app; change password if not you

messages.body_text: We blocked a sign-in to your Northwind online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT. If this wasn't you, sign in from the Northwind app (not from this email) and change your password.
